The strong Plop Landian economy, worth 2.19 trillion Cheese kurds a year, is quite specialized and led by the Trout Farming industry, with significant contributions from Arms Manufacturing, Information Technology, and Uranium Mining. Average income is 54,861 Cheese kurds, with the richest citizens earning 6.7 times as much as the poorest.

Crime, especially youth-related, is almost non-existent, thanks to a very well-funded police force and progressive social policies in education and welfare. Plop Land's national animal is the Kurds, which teeters on the brink of extinction due to widespread deforestation.
